 lock=(C/'device.lock').open('a');fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)

 for item in queue:

   continue

  assert t['settings']['training_routing_mode']=='straight_through'

   rows=j.read(out/'eval'/(m+'_seed1001.json'));assert len(rows)==2000 and all(math.isfinite(x['spce']) for x in rows)
   assert j.sha(out/'eval/contrast_bank_seed1001.npy')==bm['bank_file_sha256']

  j.write(C/'metadata/training_queue.json',queue)

  j.write(C/'metadata'/f'{m}_seed{s}_artifact_manifest.json',dict(run=str(run),files=files,checkpoint_sha256=item['checkpoint_sha256'],evaluations=evals))
 j.write(C/'metadata/status.json',dict(state='worker_queue_complete',completed=sum(x['state']=='complete' for x in queue),jobs=10,master_import='pending',updated_utc=stamp()))
try:main()
